ideas.pitch: A Python-based companion tool optimized for offline campus treasure hunts that parses riddles, tracks team checkpoint status, and streamlines Google Form submissions.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix on-ground technical treasure hunt featuring campus QR codes, riddles, and sequential challenge progression from 10 to 40 points.
ideas.title: PitStop Navigator: Campus QR and Riddle Solver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the logistical bottlenecks of a fast-paced physical scavenger hunt where speed and zero error margins determine the winner.

ideas.pitch: An F1-inspired dashboard application to monitor team checkpoint splits, puzzle hint logs, and estimated finish times during the offline treasure hunt.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix on-ground technical treasure hunt combining teamwork, strategy, speed, and point progression across multiple campus checkpoints.
ideas.title: TelemetryDash: Real-time Team Race Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns perfectly with the F1 theme of the hackathon while providing a tangible, high-speed utility that stands out in an offline race.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, local Python challenge sandbox that validates code snippets and logical reasoning puzzles instantly without relying on unstable internet connections during the campus hunt.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix pre-requisites involving basics of coding (Python), logical reasoning, and general aptitude tested across sequential stages.
ideas.title: Chicane Coder: Offline Python Puzzle Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the core technical hurdle of the event by ensuring teams can verify their code logic instantly before submitting via Google Forms.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight rule-based and regex-powered clue mapper that helps teams quickly cross-reference campus landmark names with cryptic riddle keywords.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix event flow where a riddle reveals the location of the next hidden QR code across the institute campus.
ideas.title: ApexRiddle: NLP-Assisted Campus Clue Decoders
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on strategy and speed, giving teams a competitive edge in decoding location-based clues faster than opponents.

ideas.pitch: A team strategy coordinator that logs scanned QRs, manages designated team leader email submissions, and prevents accidental rule violations.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix strict rules and regulations regarding scanning designated QRs, single team leader email submissions, and disqualification avoidance.
ideas.title: GridLock Guard: Rule Enforcement and Penalty Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to event organizers and judges by prioritizing strict compliance with event rules, ensuring the team avoids disqualification.
